description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:39
Issue: handle_chat_get always passes None as the properties argument to backend.get_objects, discarding any properties field the client sent. The generic handle_get in jmap-server (handlers.rs:40-46) correctly parses and forwards the properties slice. The chat get handler was written as a custom implementation instead of delegating to the generic handler, and in doing so silently dropped this argument.
Risk: Clients sending a properties field for Chat/get will silently receive all properties regardless, violating RFC 8620 §5.1. This divergence from the pattern set by handle_get means the same bug will reappear in any new Chat-type get handler written by copying the existing one. There is no compiler or test signal that properties is being ignored.
Fix: Delegate to jmap_server::handlers::handle_get::<Chat, B>(backend, args) as handle_chat_changes now delegates to handle_changes. If Chat-specific get behaviour is genuinely needed, document exactly what deviates and why.
title: handle_chat_get ignores properties field
